note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. There were no contests. The Returning Officer's Notice of Result, dated 24 May 1955 (Ulster Herald, 28 May 1955, p. 2), declares 36 nominated candidates elected without a poll and names three retiring councillors deemed to be re-elected, in Camderry, Drumquin and Sluggan, where no candidate was nominated. The Belfast News-Letter of 18 May 1955, p. 8 had counted 21 Unionists and 16 Nationalists returned unopposed and two divisions without a Nationalist nomination; the notice is followed here. The notice prints no labels. Returned unopposed.
